expectations.text: States the AICPA issued an exposure draft on October 28, 2026 (draft dated October 27, 2026): the Proposed 2027 SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and Description Criteria, the first major refresh since the 2017 TSC
expectations.evidence: On October 28, 2026, the AICPA's Assurance Services Executive Committee (ASEC) issued an exposure draft titled "Proposed 2027 SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and Description Criteria" (draft dated October 27, 2026). This is the first major refresh...

expectations.text: States the proposed effective date: engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027, with early adoption permitted
expectations.evidence: The proposed effective date is for engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027. Early adoption would be permitted.

expectations.text: States current engagements are unaffected: the 2017 TSC with 2022 revised points of focus remain operative
expectations.evidence: Until the AICPA finalizes and adopts the new criteria, the 2017 TSC with 2022 Revised Points of Focus are the operative criteria... It does not change your current audit.

expectations.text: Describes the direction accurately: keeps the five trust services categories, consolidates overlapping criteria, adds AI-related points of focus without new AI-specific criteria, and does not assert specific criteria counts as fact
expectations.evidence: It keeps the five trust services categories... It consolidates overlapping criteria... It adds AI-related points of focus. It does not create new AI-specific criteria. No specific criteria counts asserted.
